entries.name: Toxin of Drain Stamina
entries.sourceConsidered: Core p. 155 describes toxins in general: a coating lasts one minute or three successful hits, whichever occurs first; a damaged target uses Endurance for characteristic tests required by toxin effects. Core p. 184 supplies ingredients-plus-fee guidance.
entries.behavior: Stored effect drainStamina, level 3, 10 rounds and 3 hits. The stored school and cost agree with the current catalog entry, which alone does not prove this recipe. The old executor counted only damage events and could change hits before its card was recorded; coating and resistance cards are held for manual review.
entries.unresolved: Which source establishes this particular Toxin of Drain Stamina recipe, level 3, school, cost, effect duration and final price, and does its effect require an Endurance test?
entries.manual: The GM confirms the actual effect and ingredient recipe, records application and each successful hit even if no damage is dealt, expires the coating at the earlier limit, and resolves any characteristic test on a damaging hit using Endurance. Check prior results before modifying quantities or effects.
